description: Placed at the plant gate on ul. Szubińska on 16 July 2020; painted white/red/blue in the Bydgoszcz city colours with the city arms and the Polish chequerboard on the fin. No tactical number has been published; the markings it wears are municipal and are NOT an identity
museum_name: Su-22M4 Gate Guard -- Wojskowe Zakłady Lotnicze nr 2 Bydgoszcz
